title: 心理学実験
subtitle: Psychological Experiments
keywords: Design of psychological experiments 2.Factorial design 3.Statistical analysis
educationalGoal: Psychological experiments are a scientific method to find general rules of psychological mechanisms under strictly controlled conditions. The goal of this course is to provide students with the basic knowledge to design psychological experiments and to analyze the data from the experiments.
advice: Psychological research has the risk of misunderstanding psychological mechanisms because daily experiences are affected by various factors. To avoid this risk, psychologists developed their own scientific methodology to design experiments with strict controls of factors. This course prepares students to design their own experiments and provides basic knowledge on factorial design of experiments and statistical analyses of the data. Note: This course is required for Certified Public Psychologists & Certified Psychologists.
books: 心理学マニュアル 要因計画法[北大路書房]
requiredKnowledge: This course focuses on factorial design and statistical analysis of psychological methods. Students are required to learn the relationships between the courses of "psychological statistics" and "psychological methods".

activityGoals.body: Ability to understand factorial design and decide which experimental design is appropriate for each study.
Ability to run statistical analyses with appropriate methods.
Ability to read and understand articles applying a psychological experiment method.
Ability to understand the research methods in the important articles and apply them into your own study.
